en.askTitle: Swap in your own commute, budget and ads and get the same all-in used-car comparison
en.runTitle: Columbus, Ohio: a new nurse’s first used car, $15,000 all-in

fields.label: VINs and ads
fields.placeholder: e.g. the VIN and link for each car you are considering

fields.label: Columbus-area residence
fields.placeholder: e.g. your neighbourhood or ZIP code

fields.label: Shift rota and commute
fields.value: About 22 miles each way, often night shifts, through Ohio winters; job starts in February 2027

fields.label: Total cash and emergency reserve
fields.value: $15,000 all-in, covering price, Ohio sales tax, title and registration fees and any dealer doc fee

fields.label: Insurance quotes and loan terms
fields.placeholder: e.g. an insurance quote you were given, or a credit-union loan offer

en.template: Compare {ads} for my {home}, {commute} and {cash}. Reconcile included fees, estimate purchase and first-year cash separately, flag history, recall and winter-readiness checks, and list questions for an independent inspector. Use {quotes} if available. Plan only; do not contact sellers, apply for credit or pay.

phases.title: Collect real Columbus listings, Ohio fees, safety ratings and ownership costs
phases.note: Ads, Ohio tax and fees, crash tests, recalls and winter-tyre evidence
phases.judgment: It corrected itself with primary evidence: one Corolla ad showed $8,443 on the dealer’s own page, not the $8,948 from the search index, so the lower figure was used. It also kept crash-test results year by year (2017–18 Corolla improved, 2014–16 only “Marginal”; the 2018 Fit’s headlights rated Poor) instead of carrying a good score across model years.

phases.title: Build the comparison page with a cost calculator and a dated source list
phases.judgment: The independent colleague ran 77 separate arithmetic checks with no failures, and also flagged that the page’s opening search band of $11,000–$11,500 could break the all-cash budget: a car at $11,500 leads to a $15,188 package.

phases.title: Check the arithmetic again, then test desktop and phone layouts
phases.judgment: The hand-over keeps its limits visible: most listings rest on search-index evidence, availability is unconfirmed, and exact title and registration costs need confirming at the actual purchase.

workers: Found real used-car ads around Columbus for the six models, with price, mileage and a link for each
Checked Ohio’s official sales tax, dealer-fee cap, title and registration costs for a first car
Looked up crash tests, recalls and fuel economy for each model year, plus the case for winter tyres versus AWD
Independently recalculated the numbers and compared the ads against the source list
